decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be substantially completed within six months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P-100. Received 04/11/2018. P-101 v1_2. Received 13/12/2018. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 4 - The black colour used in painting the elements as hereby approved shall be RAL 9005.
description: Retrospective application for boundary treatment to outdoor seated area to existing restaurant and removal of the horizontal band from the ground floor front windows
